title: How much automation costs: tasks, credits, runs | 50agents
description: Automation tools charge in tasks, credits, executions or runs, and the unit decides the bill. Each tool’s unit, its entry price, and one job costed.
h1: How much automation costs: credits, tasks and runs compared
answer: Most automation and AI agent tools charge a monthly plan that includes a number of units (tasks, credits, executions or runs) and stop or charge more when you use them up.

What counts as one unit differs: Zapier counts action steps, Make module operations, n8n and Activepieces whole runs, and AI agent builders AI work, so one workflow can cost several times more in one tool than another.

method.h2: How to estimate your own cost, step by step

steps.title: List each workflow and its runs a month
steps.body: Orders a month, emails a day times 22 working days, and so on.

steps.title: Count the billable steps per run
steps.body: Per each tool’s rules. Loops multiply: a step over 5 line items is 5 in some tools.

steps.title: Add AI steps separately
steps.body: AI work is priced by how much it reads and writes. Run it 10 times and read the usage log.

steps.title: Add 30% for growth and retries
steps.body: Busy months and retried runs happen.

steps.title: Check what happens at the limit
steps.body: Some tools stop your workflows; some charge overage. Know which before it happens.

example.h2: Check one real run before you commit
body: Whatever the tool, the best estimate is one real run. In 50agents, Captain tests an automation’s steps on one real record before you build it, and every run is listed afterwards with what it did, so you can count runs and steps for your own month before you rely on it.

wrong.title: Counting steps the wrong way
wrong.body: A five-step Zap is four tasks (the trigger is free); a Make step over a list costs one credit per item. Read each tool’s rule.

wrong.title: Polling that costs when nothing happens
wrong.body: Some tools charge for checks that find nothing. Prefer instant triggers.

wrong.title: AI steps priced like fixed steps
wrong.body: An AI step that reads long emails costs far more than one that sorts a subject line. Test with real inputs.

wrong.title: Unused credits expire
wrong.body: Make’s help says unused credits expire at the end of the term; Lindy’s monthly credits do not roll over. Buy for your usual month, not your best one.

wrong.title: Quotas stop the business
wrong.body: Running out mid-month stops order logging on your busiest day. Set an alert at 80%.

faqs.q: How much does Zapier cost per task?
faqs.a: On Professional billed yearly, $19.99 buys 750 tasks, about 2.7 cents a task. Larger tiers cost less per task.

faqs.q: Is a run cheaper than a task?
faqs.a: For long workflows, yes: one run covers every step, where tasks or operations count each one. For one-step workflows they are about the same.

faqs.q: What does an AI agent cost per run?
faqs.a: It depends on how much it reads and writes. Run your AI agent on real inputs a few times and read the usage log; most builders show it per run.
